value.kbd_note: keyboard proof: type in the CommandShell (prompt echoes); the A/UX Finder drops fast clicks — hold ~0.3 s
value.note: relative ADB pointer made exact: cursor_scale 1.3333 (guest = trunc(0.75 px/unit)), SH_REL_MAX_STEP=32 + SH_REL_QUANTUM=4 keep every send in the linear range and on the model. Same q800/TCG machine and /opt/qemu-m68k binary as macos753

labctl.notes: No exec channel yet: A/UX runs no getty on the serial line (-serial unix:$D/serial.sock is wired for it). Framebuffer + adb_pointer.py against a CLONE; the CommandShell in the checkpoint scene is the keyboard proof.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# aux (slot 145) — A/UX 3.0.1 (Apple's SVR2 Unix under the Mac Finder) on the
#   same q800/68040 machine as macos753: /opt/qemu-m68k (kernel-hive fork), TCG
#   only, dbus display 1152x870x8, RELATIVE ADB pointer (dbus-rel), qcow2 PRAM.
#   A/UX disk at SCSI 0 (c0d0s0 root, s1 swap, MacPartition boots A/UX Startup).
#   Checkpoint 'golden' in the disk+PRAM pair; -loadvm golden -S; idle pause 60.

launcherParity.reason: tracked verbatim launcher equals the deployed launcher; the checkpoint was baked with this exact post-install device set (A/UX disk at SCSI 0, no helper, no CD) on the standalone /opt/qemu-m68k build

reset.fixture: A/UX 3.0.1 desktop at 1152x870x8, root logged in: CommandShell (WELCOME TO A/UX banner, ls of /, root prompt) top-left, the Unix root '/' and MacPartition volumes top-right, Trash bottom-right. Mouse tracking pinned to Very Slow (trunc(0.75 px/unit), the bridge's exact-quantum regime); games, QuickTime, man pages and networking installed from /ARCHIVES. Baked with the A/UX disk at SCSI 0 only (no helper, no CD); loadvm restores framebuffer-identical (proven: dirty -> restore -> same md5).

museum.lineage: A/UX (System V Unix, Macintosh Finder shell)
museum.blurb: Apple's own System V Unix in a Macintosh business suit — the Finder is the shell, and /bin/sh, NFS and X11 run underneath it, on the 68040 Quadra 800.
museum.notes: The only station where a proprietary GUI and a real Unix share one desktop: Mac apps and Unix processes side by side via the A/UX Toolbox. Installed on camera 2026-08-18 by copying the CD's pristine root slice; A/UX's own Easy Install then finished MacPartition and rebuilt the kernel.
